transcript: Mareez mard, 28 saal. 8 din se test hai. Bukhar hai. Sar dast hai. Kamzori bhi nahi hai. Kaan dard nahi. Bhook na lagna bilkul nahi hai. Dast bhi nahi hai. Tavanic khali pait. HB 12. Azomax paanch ml rozana. Ventolin 7 din. Ranadol do goli din mein teen baar. jab bukhar ho. 3 din baad dobara aayein.

medications.instructions: return in 3 days if fever persists
